_comment: Policy governing unattended security updates, read by security-orchestrator Phase 3. Silent = no developer interaction, NOT no trace: every auto-action lands in .agents/state/local/sca-reports/audit-log.jsonl. never_auto values below are EXAMPLES — adapt to the real project. Tune per project; in doubt, tighten.
never_auto: _comment: packages listed here are ALWAYS escalated even for a patch bump — EXAMPLES, adapt to the frameworks that structure the real project
always_escalate: _comment: iac_misconfig (trivy config — Dockerfile/Terraform/K8s/Helm) is always escalated — an infra misconfig fix is structural (editing the Dockerfile/Terraform/manifest itself), never a version-bump auto-patch

_comment: image_cve (trivy image — OS and language packages baked into a built image) is always escalated for the same structural reason, one step further: nothing in this repo declares the vulnerable package. The fix is a BASE IMAGE bump (a new FROM digest in the Dockerfile) or an upstream release we do not own — never a manifest version-bump auto-patch. Auto-fixing is not merely undesirable here, it is impossible: there is no version to raise. Note that auto_apply.finding_classes is known_cve only, so this entry states the rule rather than adding a second gate.
